English: Alora, have you seen Boo lately? I do not know where he is.
Me? No I have no idea where he is. He could not have gone far.
Where is my Boo at? Boo where are you?
Hey don't look at me, I didn't take him this time! Promise!
I am not the guilty one, Minsc. I have no need for your little pet.
I was wondering what that was I stepped on.
Hey hold on I was joking! It was a joke, I swear by Shar!
Minsc has no time for stupid jokes! Need to find Boo!
Minsc! Don't look at me like that! I would not take Boo from you.
Really Minsc! I do not have the little scoundrel. I have no use for vermin.
It would appear the little one has escaped the clutches of wrongful captivity. A smart move on his part. An animal should not be caged and...
So Cernd has freed Boo? Minsc will throttle foolish druid! ARRGHH!

(In a gasping voice) Release me and I'll explain what I meant. *cough* That's better. I just made a statement of what I thought happened, I did not release him. And I am sure he did not run away from you either. Really!
Where is Boo? Woa is me! Woa is Boo!
Hey, there he is! Looks like he was out looking for seeds. Come here Boo.
Awww! It's just the cutest little hamsty-wamsty! Who's a fuzzy Boo?
Minsc is HAPPY!! Boo is back! Come back to Minsc Boo, I should be mad at you, but I am too happy to see you!
